counting: Two additional configurations with current/temperature observations linked to earlier voltage-only records. Each configuration has one observation per branch. This does not add same-condition independent repetitions.
linking: Join by combo to transmission/n=3/<combo>/zero_load/PS01_N3_F200_ZERO_<combo>_USB_RX_VOLTAGE_R1.yaml; original voltage-only YAMLs retain their earlier intake state.
power_estimate: Use earlier source-voltage main reading times the sum of the three new branch main currents. Voltage/current photos are from different times even though filename date matches; contemporaneous source voltage is unverified. Output-side estimate excludes USB-powered Teensy and regulator losses.
known_limitations: M0-M1-M3 M0 MIN is 18.00 mA by user confirmation; the lower portion of IMG_20260907_021524.jpg does not independently verify this field. Main 18.005 mA and MAX 18.03 mA are read from the photograph.
